```python
class Fenwick:
    __slots__ = ('n','tree')
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.tree = [0]*(n+1)
    def add(self, i, v):  # 0-based index
        t = self.tree; n = self.n; i += 1
        while i <= n:
            t[i] += v
            i += i & (-i)
    def prefix(self, i):  # sum of [0, i) 0-based
        s = 0; t = self.tree; i = i  # number of elements with index < i
        while i > 0:
            s += t[i]
            i -= i & (-i)
        return s
```
